title: Cyclic chart model on the divisor
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring, let g be a nonzerodivisor with R/(g) regular, and let n be a positive integer invertible in R. Let p:Y→Spec R factor through D(g). Put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), q:Spec A→Spec R and V=D(g) in Spec A. Given an isomorphism δ:Y×_{Spec R}V≅∐_{Fin d}V over V and a point y of Spec R with g in its prime ideal, there exist a ring S, a ring map φ:R→S, and a point z of Spec S such that ψ=Spec φ is etale and ψ(z)=y. There are m≥0 and e:Fin m→N with each e(k) positive and invertible in S. Put B=∏_k S[T]/(T^{e(k)}-φ(g)), r:Spec B→Spec S and Z=D(φ(g)) in Spec B. There is an isomorphism γ:Y×_{Spec R}Spec S≅Z satisfying γ;ι_Z;r=the second projection. All schemes and rings are in universe u. Unlike the parent theorem, this statement constructs only the cover model: regularity of S, regular multiplication by φ(g), and regularity of S/(φ(g)) are proved separately by etale base change.

proof.text: Apply root_split_cover_indEtale_charts to the supplied splitting. This proves that p is affine and locally of finite presentation and supplies the ind-etale ring H, its point over y, and the finite cyclic orbit root model over H.

Apply punctured_root_charts_descend_indEtale to the affine finite-presentation p and the model over H. It descends the same finite list of exponents, their units, and the root-model isomorphism to an etale R-algebra S with a point over y.
Package S, its map and point, the fixed m and e, and the descended isomorphism and projection identity into the required existential statement.

theorem root_split_cover_on_divisor_charts
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hg : IsSMulRegular R g)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {g})]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (hj : ∃ j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g),
      j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    (d : ℕ) (y : Spec R) (hy : g ∈ y.asIdeal) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R →+* S) (z : Spec S),
      Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ∧
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) z = y ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
        (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : S)) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (φ g))))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (φ g)))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (φ g))) (φ g))
        ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
